dataIdInfo.idAbs: Structural Geophysics Tool (SGTool) for ArcGIS Pro: potential-field grid processing (reductions, continuation, filters, derivatives), convolution filters and windowed statistics, apparent susceptibility and density, Euler deconvolution, worms, gridding and utilities. The same calculations as the SGTool QGIS plugin. The Launch SGTool GUI tool opens a multi-tab window with live preview; the other tools run one calculation each.
